worldcombat.skill.headcharge.summary: Charges through multiple enemies, striking each once without stopping on a hit. Every successful hit causes recoil based on the target’s actual damage taken.
worldcombat.skill.headcharge.description: The head deals about %1$s contact damage to each enemy struck along the charge, travelling up to %2$s blocks at %3$s blocks per tick with a %4$s block collision radius.

Hits each enemy once and continues until the distance is spent, a wall is struck or movement is blocked. Each hit causes recoil equal to %1$s of the target’s actual damage taken. After the first target, later targets receive %2$s power and are each pushed up to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.headcharge.hunt.on: Homing: the charge steers toward the nearest enemy (up to %1$s degrees per tick), catching targets that sidestep - at the cost of charge power x0.92, knockback x0.85 and wind-up +2 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.headcharge.hunt.off: Straight line: maximum power and knockback, but one sidestep puts the target clear.
worldcombat.skill.headcharge.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %5$s s, costing %4$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.headcharge.growth.0: From level %1$s, base impact power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.headcharge.growth.1: From level %1$s, base impact power rises to %2$s and the power fraction for later targets to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.headcharge.use.0: Hurl a line of enemies in one straight charge
worldcombat.skill.headcharge.use.1: Deliver a powerful charge at the cost of recoil
worldcombat.skill.headcharge.use.2: Chase a sidestepping target with the homing form
On: the charge steers toward the nearest enemy (with a turn limit), catching targets that sidestep - at the cost of power, knockback and a longer wind-up. Off: a dead straight line with maximum power and knockback, but one sidestep puts the target clear.
Within this distance the user starts the charge; smaller stays in your face, larger charges from further out.
On: prefer starting the charge when more enemies are lined up behind the target. Off: choose by threat alone.
